info.name: Psychology Module API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Psychology Testing Module.

Supports:
- PAPI Kostick (90 questions, 20 scales)
- EPPS (225 questions, 15 needs)
- Dynamic test types (admin paste JSON questions)
- Package & Price management
- Invitation-based registration (self-service)
- Hybrid scoring (frontend preview, backend verify)

## Test Flow A: Admin Creates Patient
1. Login as Admin
2. Create Test Type (paste questions JSON)
3. Create Package (single/bundle)
4. Create Patient
5. Create Order → Get Access Token
6. Public: Start Session with Token
7. Public: Submit Answers
8. Admin: View & Verify Results

## Test Flow B: Invitation Link (Self-Registration)
1. Login as Admin
2. Create Package
3. Create Invitation (set maxUses, expiry)
4. Share invitation link to candidates
5. Candidate: GET /public/invite/:code (see package info)
6. Candidate: POST /public/invite/:code/register (self-register)
7. Candidate receives accessToken automatically
8. Public: Use accessToken to take tests
